answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Work waits on the island until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the kernel of the next round. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the fable of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
